payload.title: Connect explicit Localization obligations and witness decisions to native coding Context
payload.summary: Priority1 INTEGRATION. Native ContextTools/CodingCommands provide scoped search/read/edit/checks but no maintained call to acquire_localization_lexical_evidence, candidate generation/resolution or assess_localization_readiness. Existing experiments compose these under host-authored treatments; no complete native consumer exists. Implement one opt-in bounded application consumer of an explicitly trusted caller-authored task/obligation frame and existing native evidence/decision APIs. Do not infer task completeness from ranks or create an autonomous planner.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: an authorized task with explicit mandatory/helpful/conditional obligations obtains scoped evidence; records complementary and competing candidates and explicit supported/contradicted/unresolved decisions; promotes only fully supported witnesses by existing APIs; reports BLOCKED/CONDITIONAL/READY accurately with exact assessment identity coverage. Demonstrate result reaching a model request or native correlated Tool response and affecting an auditable acquisition/stop action. Include absent, incomplete, stale, forged, unsupported, deferred and over-bound inputs; no automatically invented accepted alternatives, no publication authority, no lost lexical escape. Scripted integration is not empirical effectiveness; actual native use must be labeled separately.
payload.uncertainty: ADR-0005 permits bounded caller interpretation and semantic recording, not a universal planner or automatic satisfaction. Decide the minimum application surface before implementation; source/Tool permissions and native completion remain separate. Maintenance-agent suitability: only with frozen trusted frame and independent negative oracle.
